bug: Numeric entailment treated identifier fragments such as v3 vs v3.2 as contradictory quantities, and low-trust 'not an official source' spans outranked primary CEO evidence. Also bankrupt queries could cite earnings text that never mentioned bankruptcy.
fix: Require two-digit or decimal numbers for numeric entailment/conflict; penalize official-source negation and off-topic earnings/bankrupt spans.
scope: Rerun ALL FINAL rows after the harness fix. No gold-label edits. No selective rerun.
follow_up: Scorer now matches dotted numeric golds inside version strings (v3.2). Negation in article-body lookups is treated as an answer, not a contradiction. Primary sources are preferred over low-trust 'not an official source' commentary.
